features.name: Martial Arts Training
features.exact_effect: Proficient with unarmed strikes; may use Dexterity for their attack and damage rolls.
limitations: The adopted unarmed damage die is 1d4.

features.name: Combat Discipline
features.exact_effect: Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks when analyzing combat situations or opponents.
features.information_boundary: May reveal apparent stance, focus, readiness, fighting approach, or immediate tactical intent; never thoughts, statistics, alignment, or objective truth.

features.name: Combat Communication
exact_effect: Advantage on Insight checks to read emotions during combat.
Once per short rest, after a meaningful brief sparring match, advantage on one Charisma check.
features.limitations: No blanket Persuasion advantage and no compulsion or mind reading.

features.name: Force Connection

exact_effect.passive: May sense significant Force disturbances without automatically learning identity, location, or explanation.
exact_effect.focused: As an action, focus on one visible creature within 30 feet and gain advantage on one Insight check before the end of Aero's next turn to read emotional state or apparent concealment.

features.limitations: Cannot read thoughts, memories, statistics, alignment, or objective truth; Force shielding may block it.

features.name: Sentinel Balance
features.trigger: After failing a Dexterity or Charisma save but before consequences resolve.
features.exact_effect: Add 1d4 to the failed saving throw, potentially turning it into a success.
features.limitations: Two uses per long rest; cannot affect attacks, checks, damage, AC, or successful saves.

features.name: Lightsaber Deflect - Tier 1
features.trigger: Hit by a perceptible ranged energy attack while wielding an active lightsaber and not incapacitated.
features.exact_effect: Reduce damage by 1d10+2. If reduced to zero, Aero may make a +5 ranged deflection attack against one visible creature within 30 feet; on a hit it deals the original attack's rolled damage without adding Dexterity.
features.limitations: Cannot affect area attacks, explosions, environmental damage, melee attacks, or attacks declared non-deflectable; normally once per round.

features.name: Former Master and Jedi Network
features.exact_effect: Knows Master Taron's last confirmed region and how to identify or locate established Jedi safe houses and trusted contacts. Reasonably available contacts may offer guidance, basic information, or temporary shelter.
features.limitations: Does not guarantee supplies, credits, transport, obedience, or safety; specific contacts and safe houses are established only through sourced play.

features.name: Echani Grappling Training
features.exact_effect: With a free hand, make a Dexterity-based martial check at +5 against the target's Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics). On success, the target is grappled and its speed becomes 0.
limitations: Target may be no more than one size larger.
Deals no damage and grants no attack advantage by itself.
Drag at half speed; target may use its action for a contested escape; release freely.
Shove or Takedown requires a separate attack and contest.
Pushing the target away normally ends the grapple.

powers.name: Battle Insight
powers.exact_effect: Choose one visible creature. Aero has advantage on his next attack against it. The effect ends after that attack, if concentration breaks, if the target becomes invalid, or after 1 minute.
powers.rules_status: Confirmed effect with adopted duration override; source duration is 1 round.

powers.name: Burst
powers.exact_effect: Every other creature in the radius, including allies, makes a Dexterity save against DC 12. Failure deals 1d4 force damage and knocks the creature prone; success causes neither. Aero is unaffected.
powers.rules_status: Level, cost, radius, and damage confirmed; save, self-exclusion, success result, and prone rider are adopted table rulings.

armor.name: Dark-grey Jedi robes with Master Taron's Mornos Synthweave mantle
exact_effects: Advantage on qualifying diplomacy checks when recognized Jedi status materially assists.
The mantle repairs ordinary minor cuts, scorch marks, and wear during a short rest.
The mantle grants no AC bonus.

facts: The Meridian Reach is a frontier sector of scattered settlements joined by old trade lanes and volunteer relays.
Jedi serving the Reach are called the Walking Cloaks — they walk fields, repair pumps, and serve without ceremony.
Nona Ladiern's Harvest Festival is two weeks away; Nona Ladiern is a frontier festival figure, not a crew member.
The mission: escort six Republic engineers to reactivate an abandoned frontier beacon relay (sensor array). Restore the station, confirm the signal, bring everyone home.
Aero was recently knighted; his master Vael Taron is missing; the Stillwater records are sealed.
The shuttle is in transit; nothing anomalous has been detected en route.
Aero has never met the three operatives before this mission.
prohibitions: No invented rituals, ancient events, dark-side phenomena, energy signatures, or named lore absent from canon or chronicle.
Force Connection reads emotional state and apparent concealment only — never thoughts, memories, or objective truth.
No Republic-founding ceremonies attached to the Harvest Festival.

I kill Dax with my lightsaber brutally
